title: mt-sigma-algebra widget params
description: The σ-algebra generated by a family of subsets, on the finite set X={1,2,3,4}. Toggle generators from a bank into the family E; the widget computes the partition of X into atoms (points sharing the same membership pattern across all generators), colours X by atom, and lists every element of σ(E) — exactly the unions of atoms, so |σ(E)|=2^(#atoms). It checks the three σ-algebra axioms (∅∈A, closed under complement, closed under union) on the result, and presets sweep from the trivial {∅,X} through a single event and a partition to the discrete 2^X.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper.
